meta.title: D365 Toolkit
meta.description: Developer and deployment toolkit for Dynamics 365 CE: metadata, layers, migration risk, code checks, contract drift and environment health.

d365_envs.title: Environments
d365_envs.description: List configured environments, credential status and connectivity

d365_metadata.title: Metadata
d365_metadata.description: Query entities, attributes, forms, views, plugins and solutions by resource

d365_layers.title: Solution layers
d365_layers.description: See which solutions cover a component and which layer is active

d365_sync.title: Sync snapshot
d365_sync.description: Pull environment metadata into a local snapshot and record completeness

d365_diff.title: Diff snapshots
d365_diff.description: Compare two snapshots: additions, deletions and field-level edits

d365_configure.title: Configure environments
d365_configure.description: List, save, remove or test environment definitions

d365_write.title: Metadata changes
d365_write.description: Plan option values, attributes, table names and view columns, then apply after approval

d365_migrate.title: Migration risk
d365_migrate.description: Assess importing a solution elsewhere: shadowing, missing components, lost option values

d365_code_check.title: Code change check
d365_code_check.description: Read a GitLab MR and check whether script and plugin changes will run in the target environment

d365_refs.title: References
d365_refs.description: Which forms, views and flows use a field, which forms load a script, which steps a plugin has

d365_data.title: Query data
d365_data.description: Count, group or sample business records (requires environment permission)

d365_data_write.title: Write data
d365_data_write.description: Create or update one business record after approval (requires environment permission)

d365_contract.title: Contract drift
d365_contract.description: Check plugin registrations, form scripts and sitemaps across environments, with waivers

d365_health.title: Environment health
d365_health.description: Suspended and failed jobs, running imports and publishes, recently installed solutions

d365_reports.title: Local data
d365_reports.description: Inspect local artifact usage, clean up by retention policy or compact snapshots
